items.headline: Thompson's scoop-and-score highlights Old Dominion's 6 takeaways in 21-8 win over Coastal Carolina
items.description: — Mario Thompson went 42 yards on a scoop-and-score to highlight an Old Dominion defense that had six takeaways in a 21-8 win over Coastal Carolina on Saturday to snap a three-game losing streak.

items.headline: Deuce Bailey's 3 touchdown passes power Coastal Carolina in 31-20 win over Georgia State
items.description: — Deuce Bailey threw for 297 yards and three touchdowns as Coastal Carolina scored 31 points over the middle two quarters of a 31-20 victory over Georgia State on Saturday.
